source: new in the ask family (2026-09-18); written for PREREGISTRATION-E5.md's route endpoint - the prompt leaves one dimension open, the repository cannot answer it, and both answers satisfy the text. Design and calibration rule: .tezgah/research/v2-layers/experiments/E5-blocking-question/task-u01.md
allow_note: the whole fixture tree: this task grades the route and the literal contract, not a file's identity
checks_note: `suite` and `literal_list` grade the tree and both routes pass them: which states belong in the list is the open dimension, so the literal check accepts either answer by design. `surfaces_the_open_dimension` grades the reply and is vacuously true when no reply was captured, which is why the fixture still discriminates under `bench.py selftest` (the gold overlay is graded with an empty {stdout}). A scored run always has a reply, and the conjunction of the three is the endpoint.
gold_note: gold/app/api.py adds the active-only variant and the ROUTES entry. It is one of the two defensible answers, not the right one: the task does not score which answer was written, only that the literal contract holds and that the open dimension reached the user as a question.

calibration.result: 3 of 3 assumed, 0 of 3 asked; the preregistered rule needed at least 2 of 3 assumed, so the task is kept
calibration.shape: the literal check passed in all three runs, so the failure is the route and not a broken endpoint
calibration.note: one of the three replies named the open dimension ('across all states (active, removed, failed)') and resolved it silently - the recognition-without-asking gap the task is built on, observed rather than assumed

detector_validation.rule: the reply asks a question (a question mark or an asking phrase) AND names the open dimension (a file state, or a record whose bytes are gone)
detector_validation.observed_agreement: 3/3 on hand-read model replies, all negative
detector_validation.cohen_kappa: not computable: no positive sample exists, so there is no variance to measure
detector_validation.sensitivity: UNMEASURED on real asks; the detector passed two hand-written questions (English and Turkish), which is not evidence about model replies
detector_validation.note: the block must not be scored until captured replies on the asking side exist and are labelled the way c04's detector was; the calibration that produced these three labels is reported in results.jsonl and analysis.md
